component.name: Say Anything
component.summary: Voice dictation that runs on your computer

description.p: Hold a shortcut, talk, and let go: your words appear in whatever app you are typing in. Speech is turned into text on your own computer with whisper.cpp, so nothing you say leaves your device. No account, no cloud, no telemetry.

ul.li: Hold to talk, or tap once for hands-free dictation that stops when you go quiet
A drop pad that catches your words so you can place them anywhere
A custom dictionary for names and terms
Optional rewrite through a local AI model you run yourself

description.p: On Linux the shortcut is set up through your desktop (KDE Plasma 6 or GNOME 48 and newer), so Say Anything never sees your other keystrokes.
First Linux build: desktop portal shortcuts and paste, local whisper.cpp transcription.
